Unit set rules

  • One named behavior per case; no multi-purpose “works” test.
  • Avoid network timing when isolated state can prove the contract.
  • Clean up every timer, handler, socket, and temporary resource.
  • Treat the generated execution result—not this inventory—as pass/fail authority.
